@FabianLars @snorkysnark Any idea if / when this will get merged? 

Was literally just tinkering with https://github.com/FabianLars/tauri-plugin-deep-link the past couple days and just arrived at the conclusion this is very likely exactly whats needed as the deep link crate's `.desktop` file isnt getting bundled into the `.deb` and `.appimage`

Nope no idea. But this also won't fix the plugin if you have any problems with it (or well, it could but it shouldn't be necessary). The plugin will write the desktop file to disk dynamically using content from [_inside_ the binary](https://github.com/FabianLars/tauri-plugin-deep-link/blob/main/src/linux.rs#L40) (meaning it doesn't need to separately bundle the file).

(p.s. if you have any issues with the plugin feel free to open an issue over there)

issue_context.title: [feat] custom .desktop file template
issue_context.body:
### Describe the problem

I'm trying to implement a custom URL scheme in my app, and as demonstrated by https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/323#issuecomment-920928947 this is already possible on Windows using a custom wix template.
It would be pretty easy to do on Linux as well, but it requires some changes to the .desktop file: namely adding a MimeType field and appending `%u` after Exec:
```
[Desktop Entry]
Categories=Development;
Exec=app-name %u
Icon=app-name
Name=app-name
Terminal=false
Type=Application
MimeType=x-scheme-handler/customprotocol
```

### Describe the solution you'd like

Use a handlebars template for .desktop file generation, the same way it works for wix:
```json
"deb": {
    "depends": [],
    "desktopTemplate": ""
},
```
```
[Desktop Entry]
Categories={{{categories}}}
Exec={{{exec}}}
Icon={{{icon}}}
Name={{{name}}}
Terminal=false
Type=Application
```
I can make a PR later if you aggree on this change

### Alternatives considered

_No response_

### Additional context

_No response_
